AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter
 Organic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting
 About Us
 Impact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company. Through courses, coaching, and software, we help everyday people develop practical skills and build digital product businesses.
 We are launching an exciting new business division focused on AI avatars, viral health and wellness content, and supplement affiliate marketing.
 We are hiring a full-time AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter to join our internal team and help us build a portfolio of highly successful Instagram and Facebook accounts that generate millions of organic views and drive supplement sales.
 Your primary mission is simple: Research viral content, write exceptional short-form scripts, and turn organic views into supplement affiliate revenue.
 This is a hands-on creative position for someone who understands how to capture attention, write compelling health and wellness content, and turn social media engagement into measurable revenue.
 Company: Impact Clients
Website: https://go.impactclients.co/ Language: English
Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)
Time Zone: ET business-hour overlap preferred
Work Type: Full-Time, Remote
Industry: Health & Wellness, Supplements, AI Avatars, Affiliate Marketing, Direct Response
Expected Compensation: 2,000 - 3,000 USD/month
 Our Business Model
 We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.
 Rather than using traditional human influencers, we use AI-generated avatars to create engaging, educational, and entertaining short-form videos.
 Here's how the business works:
 Research Viral Content: Identify high-performing health and wellness videos, trending topics, proven hooks, and compelling educational angles.
 Write Scripts: Turn research into original, attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook Reel scripts designed to maximize retention, engagement, and sharing.
 Create AI Avatar Videos: Our production team uses AI avatar technology and video editing to bring your scripts to life.
 Drive Organic Traffic: Publish content across our Instagram and Facebook accounts to generate views, followers, and product interest.
 Generate Affiliate Revenue: Direct interested viewers toward relevant supplements sold through affiliate partners, including Amazon product pages, where purchases can generate commissions.
 Our goal is to build a repeatable, scalable content engine that consistently produces viral videos and generates meaningful affiliate revenue.
 You will be responsible for the research, hooks, storytelling, and scripts that power this entire operation.
 Example Accounts & Creative References
 Below are examples of Instagram accounts operating in the type of health and wellness content space we are entering.
 Please review these accounts before applying to understand the general content formats, topics, and creative styles we are looking to develop:
 Nutrition Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/nutrition.is.greatness/reels/ 
 Wellness Everyday Health: https://www.instagram.com/wellnesseverydayhealth/reels/ 
 Homestead Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/homestead.wellness.daily/reels/ 
 Tyler Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/tylerwellnessdaily/reels/ 
 Health Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/health.is.greatness/reels/ 
 Travis on Wellness: https://www.instagram.com/travisonwellness/reels/ 
 These accounts are provided as creative references for the type of organic health and wellness content we intend to produce.
 Your responsibility will be to research what makes content successful in this market and develop original scripts that can achieve comparable or better results.
 We are looking for someone who can identify proven viral patterns and turn them into original, engaging, revenue-generating content—not simply copy or rewrite another creator's videos.
 Responsibilities
 Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
 Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.
 Develop compelling hooks: Write attention-grabbing openings that stop viewers from scrolling and make them want to watch the entire video.
 Master short-form storytelling: Structure scripts with compelling introductions, curiosity, educational value, and natural transitions into product-related calls to action.
 Research supplement products: Understand the supplements we promote, their ingredients, intended uses, consumer interests, and approved product positioning.
 Write product-focused content: Develop educational and promotional content around health topics that naturally connects to relevant supplement products.
 Optimize for revenue: Understand that our goal is not simply generating millions of views, but producing content that translates into clicks, qualified product interest, and affiliate commissions.
 Collaborate with AI video editors: Work closely with our AI avatar production team to ensure scripts translate into compelling final videos.
 Analyze performance: Review metrics including views, average watch time, engagement, clicks, and attributable sales to identify successful formats and improve future scripts.
 Build repeatable content systems: Organize research, winning hooks, proven angles, and creative templates to help our team consistently produce high-performing content at scale.
 Maintain compliance: Ensure health and supplement scripts avoid unsubstantiated medical claims, misleading representations, and prohibited claims while following applicable FTC guidance, affiliate disclosure rules, and platform policies.
 Continuously improve: Test different hooks, messaging angles, storytelling structures, and calls to action based on performance feedback.
 Must-Haves
 Strong copywriting ability, particularly for short-form videos, direct-response marketing, or social media content.
 Demonstrated ability to research viral content and understand why certain videos outperform others.
 Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and short-form content retention.
 Ability to write engaging scripts that communicate complex topics in simple, compelling language.
 Strong research skills and an ability to identify interesting health and wellness topics from credible sources.
 Understanding of persuasive writing, consumer psychology, curiosity-driven hooks, and effective calls to action.
 Ability to produce scripts consistently at high volume without sacrificing quality.
 Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing while maintaining originality and accuracy.
 Willingness to learn about supplements, affiliate marketing, and direct-response content monetization.
 Strong attention to detail, ability to follow feedback, and willingness to iterate based on performance.
 Excellent written English and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
 Nice To Haves
 Experience writing viral Instagram or Facebook Reels that have generated 1M+ views.
 Experience writing direct-response copy specifically for supplements, health, wellness, nutrition, or longevity products.
 Proven track record writing social content that has generated measurable clicks, conversions, or affiliate revenue.
 Familiarity with AI avatar platforms, AI video generation, or faceless content production.
 Experience with supplement affiliate programs, Amazon Associates, or similar performance-based marketing models.
 Understanding of Facebook and Instagram algorithms, retention metrics, and organic content distribution.
 Experience writing comment-to-DM calls to action or using ManyChat-style automation workflows.
 Familiarity with supplement advertising compliance, health-related advertising restrictions, and affiliate disclosure standards.
 Experience creating high volumes of original content across multiple social media accounts.
 What Success Looks Like
 We are not hiring someone to simply write scripts and check boxes.
 We are hiring someone who is excited about the challenge of building a brand-new revenue division through viral content.
 Success in this position means:
 Consistently identifying promising viral content opportunities before they become oversaturated.
 Producing original scripts that achieve strong watch time, engagement, and organic reach.
 Developing repeatable winning formats that can be replicated across multiple accounts.
 Collaborating effectively with our AI avatar production team to maintain a consistent content pipeline.
 Creating content that generates meaningful affiliate clicks, supplement purchases, and attributable revenue.
 Continuously improving creative performance through research, testing, and iteration.
 Ultimately, we want a copywriter who thinks like both a creative strategist and a direct-response marketer.
 You should care just as much about whether a video generates sales as you do about whether it generates views.
 Our Core Values
 We believe that an exceptional company is built by exceptional people.
 Impact Clients has grown from zero to multiple eight figures without outside funding because our team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, high standards, and a shared commitment to our customers.
 Our three core values define how we work:
 1. Client Success = Company Success
 Everything we do, from marketing and sales to coaching and fulfillment, exists to create the best possible outcomes for our customers.
 Client success always comes first.
 2. 1% Better Every Day
 We believe in constantly improving, both personally and professionally.
 Whether that's working out, reading, learning new skills, or sharing valuable ideas, our team takes personal growth seriously.
 We encourage continuous development—physically, mentally, and spiritually—and regularly share books, podcasts, lessons, and reflections with each other.
 3. FIO — Figure It Out
 We are an entrepreneurial, resourceful team of owners.
 We believe in hiring people who can take initiative, solve problems independently, and operate with very little micromanagement.
 Every team member is encouraged to treat their division like their own business, take full ownership of results, and find creative solutions to challenges.
 We believe that if you want to go fast, you go alone; if you want to go far, you go together. That's why we all choose as individuals to grow with this team because we are committed to the vision of building a billion-dollar enterprise-value organization, and having a ton of fun along the way.
 We work hard, set high standards, and genuinely enjoy building alongside talented, ambitious people.
 Benefits & Opportunity
 Competitive compensation: 2,000–3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.
 Build a new division: Join at the ground floor of an exciting new AI avatar and supplement affiliate marketing business.
 Creative autonomy: Research viral content, test fresh angles, and develop your own creative approaches to generating organic growth.
 High-growth environment: Work inside an established, multiple-eight-figure company launching a new revenue channel.
 Work with AI technology: Collaborate with a team using AI avatars, video generation, and modern content production tools.
 Growth opportunities: Potential to expand into senior copywriting, creative strategy, or content leadership responsibilities as the division grows.
 Fully remote: Work remotely with a results-oriented team that values autonomy, ownership, and execution.
 Entrepreneurial culture: Join a team of ambitious people committed to personal growth, excellence, and building something meaningful together.
 How To Apply
 If you're passionate about viral content, direct-response copywriting, AI technology, and health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.
 Please be prepared to share examples of your previous copywriting work, particularly short-form video scripts, along with any available performance metrics demonstrating results.
 We are looking for someone who wants to do more than write content.
 We want someone who can help us build a viral content engine that consistently generates millions of views and turns that attention into real, measurable revenue.
 Apply below to join our team.

Through our fully integrated proprietary technology platform, we recover rare earths from end-of-life products and transform them into high-purity materials used to produce new permanent magnets. We have established an extensive and growing network of commercial partnerships with global industry leaders such as Solvay, Vattenfall, Lime, and VACUUMSCHMELZE, enabling the rapid deployment of recycled rare earth materials into real-world supply chains. Joining Cyclic Materials means tackling complex and exciting challenges at scale alongside a team committed to strong execution and measurable impact. You will combine manufacturing data analysis with hands-on lab debug and cross-functional execution to identify issues, recommend corrective actions, and help drive them to closure.

 Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to cross-functional engineering and program teams.

 Familiarity with coherent optical transceivers, optical modems, DSP-based systems, or high-speed communications hardware. 
 Familiarity with high-volume manufacturing, manufacturing test flows, factory yield analysis, or production data systems. 
 Experience with optical test equipment, electrical test equipment, automated test platforms, reliability qualification testing, failure analysis, or root-cause corrective action processes.

We're looking for a Director, Platform Engineering to build that foundation — and lead the team behind it. That’s where you come in.

You'll own the developer experience end to end: CI/CD, deployment automation, observability, AI-assisted development tooling, test infrastructure, and the developer-facing infrastructure layer. This is a chance to define a platform mandate from scratch, partner directly with the VP of Engineering and CTO, and shape how Maple's engineering team builds software as we scale. The work you do here will compound — every hour your team saves a product engineer is an hour that goes back into the patient and provider experience.
Your responsibilities : As the Director of Platform Engineering, you’ll: 
 Own the platform engineering team's mandate end-to-end: developer environment, CI/CD and deployment pipelines, test infrastructure and quality tooling, framework and dependency health, AI tooling for engineers, and the AI feature tooling stack
 Serve Maple's product engineering squads as your primary customer — publish a platform roadmap, run developer surveys, and make prioritization calls based on developer friction data
 Drive engineering metrics in partnership with the VP of Engineering — stand up the tooling to measure developer experience, define the quantitative baselines, and set the roadmap to move them
 Hire, coach, and grow a small team of engineers, and set the operating model, rituals, and career expectations for the team
 Partner across Engineering, Business Technology, Security, Data, and Product to lead change — from shifting the org from manual to continuous deployment, to raising the bar on quality, observability, and incident response
 Stay hands-on where it matters: architecture reviews, prototyping, and unblocking your direct reports — while making sure the platform team stays a thin, high-leverage layer rather than an over-engineered one
 Translate platform investment into business outcomes for non-technical executive leaders and connect the team's roadmap to Maple's growth priorities

 In the following 12–18 months, you'll have moved Maple to continuous deployment on both backend and frontend, established a framework upgrade cadence that keeps the stack healthy, and matured E2E test infrastructure that runs on every PR. You'll have formalized incident management and an on-call rotation, matured our agentic engineering tooling, and put an AI evaluation harness in place.  Director-level operating experience — you've owned a multi-domain technical roadmap and worked as a peer to other Directors and senior cross-functional leaders

 Deep expertise in modern CI/CD and deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent, feature flag systems, progressive delivery, automated quality gates), and cloud infrastructure fluency (AWS preferred) — enough to be a credible counterpart to Business Technology in technical conversations
 Strong grounding in observability, incident management, and quality engineering — Datadog, SLOs, on-call design, blameless postmortems, E2E test frameworks, and shift-left quality

 Participer à l’analyse, au design et à l’implémentation de nouvelles fonctionnalités d’une plateforme Cloud moderne basée sur une architecture microservices tant du côté backend que frontend

 Baccalauréat en génie informatique, génie logiciel, en sciences informatiques ou expérience équivalente.

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Workplace Project Manager, you'll take our workplace playbooks and standards and turn them into delivered projects and programs on the ground - office moves and openings, and global special projects like health & safety programming, design standards, emergency response planning, WVPPs, sustainability, and new tooling rollouts. This is a hands-on delivery role: you own scope, schedule, and budget for each project or program and drive it from kickoff to close.



Where the program sets the standard, your projects and programs bring it to life - on time, on budget, and to spec.







WHAT YOU'LL DO



Global Special Projects



 - Project manage Workplace's global special projects: health & safety (H&S) programming, global design standards, global emergency response programming, Workplace Violence Prevention Plans (WVPPs), and sustainability programming across Harvey's office portfolio.

 - Partner with Security, HR, Legal, and regional Workplace leads to build and roll out emergency response plans and WVPPs that meet local regulatory requirements while staying consistent with Harvey's global standards.

 - Maintain and evolve global design standards (furniture, finishes, signage) so offices feel consistently "Harvey" as we scale into new markets.

 - Drive sustainability initiatives across offices - vendor and materials selection, energy and waste programs - and track progress against goals.

 - Own the global rollout of Workplace tooling and software - evaluating, piloting, and implementing platforms like desk booking, occupancy, and ticketing, and driving stakeholder training and adoption.

 - Own global and national vendor contracts (F&B, janitorial, plants, and similar categories) - procurement, negotiation, and the master vendor relationship - while regional workplace managers own the day-to-day relationship, performance, and feedback in their offices.




Global Playbook & Portfolio Management (Moves & Openings)

 - Build and maintain the FDOB checklist and playbook that regional workplace leads execute against for satellite moves, expansions, and new-office openings.

 - Own the portfolio-level calendar tracking when and where expansions and new offices are happening across the org, so Workplace can sequence and resource projects appropriately.

 - Step in to lead a move, opening, or buildout directly where a region doesn't yet have an established workplace manager, or where the existing regional team doesn't have the bandwidth - expect this to be a shrinking share of the role over time as regional coverage matures.

 - Coordinate with IT, Security, and AV to keep day-one readiness standards current in the playbook, so regional teams can deliver consistently without you running each project personally.



Program Management



 - Build and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets across global programs and the FDOB playbook; track milestones, dependencies, and risks, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

 - Maintain the portfolio-level view across all in-flight and planned moves, openings, and buildouts, flagging sequencing and resourcing risks to leadership.

 - Manage vendor relationships tied to your global contracts and programs, holding them accountable to schedule and quality.

 - Report to the Global Workplace Operations Manager to ensure every program and playbook meets Harvey's workplace standards and sets regional teams up for smooth steady-state operations.







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years in workplace operations, program management, or project management, with experience leading cross-functional programs such as health & safety, emergency preparedness, sustainability, or systems/tooling rollouts.

 - Strong program design and playbook-building instincts - you'd rather build a system and standard that others execute against well than run every project yourself.

 - Experience managing vendor and procurement relationships at a national or global scale.

 - Strong command of project management fundamentals - scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder communication.

 - Experience partnering with (not necessarily owning) construction, real estate, or facilities teams on office moves or buildouts.

 - Excellent organizational and communication skills; you keep complex, fast-moving programs on track and everyone informed.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a hands-on, get-it-done approach.

 - Based in Toronto and able to work on-site at our Toronto office, with willingness to travel to other sites as projects require.




NICE TO HAVE 

 - Experience building or administering H&S programs, emergency response plans, or WVPPs.

 - Experience with sustainability program design or reporting.

 - Familiarity with project / workplace tools - e.g., Asana, Smartsheet, Envoy, OfficeSpace.

 - Experience building playbooks or programs that scale across a distributed, multi-region team.

 Une nouvelle ère pour l’industrie de l’aluminium – ELYSIS
 Aluminium sans carbone
 La technologie ELYSIS™ représente la plus grande avancée dans l’industrie de l’aluminium depuis 1886. Des efforts sont présentement déployés afin de perfectionner cette nouvelle façon révolutionnaire de produire de l’aluminium, qui élimine le dioxyde de carbone et toutes les autres émissions de gaz à effet de serre du procédé conventionnel d’électrolyse.
 Le procédé ELYSIS élimine l’utilisation d’anodes de carbone, en les remplaçant par des matériaux brevetés. En tant que premier procédé industriel qui émet de l’oxygène comme sous-produit, il a le potentiel de transformer toute l’industrie.
 En 2018, deux producteurs d’aluminium de calibre international, Alcoa et Rio Tinto, ont uni leurs forces afin de créer la coentreprise ELYSIS avec le gouvernement du Québec. Bénéficiant du soutien du gouvernement du Canada et la technologie progresse et elle est actuellement conçue pour être utilisée aussi bien dans des projets de construction que de modernisation d’alumineries. 
 ELYSIS a son siège social à Montréal, avec des centres de recherche et de développement à Alma et à Jonquière, au Québec (Canada), ainsi qu’à New Kensington, en Pennsylvanie (États-Unis) et en France.
 Du métal de qualité commerciale produit par ELYSIS dans nos installations R&D et au centre de développement industriel est déjà utilisé par Apple dans un éventail de produits (comme le MacBook Pro 16 po et l’iPhone SE), par AB InBev (canettes) et par Audi (roues du e-tron GT, fabriquées par le RONAL Group).

 Carbon Free Aluminium

The Department of Cognitive & Behavioral Science Laboratory Technician supports teaching and research activities related to the department’s technological resources, equipment, and facilities. The position manages installation and maintenance of software programs and laboratory equipment, monitors and maintains consumable supply inventories, provides logistical and instructional support of laboratory-based courses, instructs undergraduate students in specific technological, laboratory and research skills, and provides logistical support of faculty research programs.
 To achieve our mission as a liberal arts university, we continually strive to foster a welcoming campus community, which recognizes the value of all persons. Our department is committed to contributing to an educational environment that is rich with a wide range of intellectual perspectives and backgrounds.
 Essential Functions: 
 Assists faculty with technical instruction of lectures and laboratories, including presenting laboratory demonstrations and common research-related content such as research ethics, IRB and IACUC protocols, policies and guidelines.
 Assists in preparing chemical solutions, sets up instrumentation, and ensures adequate supplies for classroom demonstrations, course laboratories, and faculty research projects.
 Assists in the teaching mission of the department by supporting faculty in the development of new experiments, demonstrations, and activities for teaching labs and courses.
 Assists students with course projects, independent studies, research design, statistical procedures, and written feedback on IRB proposals to facilitate IRB approval and project development.
 Coordinates with animal care staff and assists in training and oversight of students in support of faculty teaching and research programs to ensure compliance with IACUC standards and IACUC-approved animal use protocols. Assists faculty in training and oversight of students in animal behavioral and histological procedures. 
 Develops, maintains, and disseminates procedures for equitable in-person participant recruitment for course-related and programmatic research.
 Supports productive and efficient faculty research programs by assisting faculty with logistics of conducting research.
 Maintains and supports departmental facilities including overseeing the general condition, cleanliness, and safety of instructional laboratories, benchtop areas, and fume hoods. Maintains, operates, assembles, and installs laboratory instruments, managing repairs and service contracts.
 Manages teaching and research laboratory equipment and supplies in a cost-effective manner within a prescribed budget. Monitors inventory, issues purchase orders, and maintains records for chemicals, supplies, and equipment while managing vendor communications.
 Coordinates with Information Technology Services on computer maintenance, repairs, replacements, and software implementation.
 Develops, maintains, and disseminates policies, processes, and standard operating procedures for access to shared research resources.
 Serves as departmental liaison to the Chemical Hygiene Officer to ensure compliance with chemical hygiene and safety standards.
 Performs other related duties as assigned.
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in psychology, neuroscience, or allied discipline. Formal postgraduate training or degree preferred.
 Experience working in a behavioral science laboratory (psychology or behavioral neuroscience setting preferred).
 Experience with statistical software (SPSS, R), experimental design/data handling software (E-Prime, Python, MATLAB), and/or survey platforms (Qualtrics, Prolific) in research contexts.
 Ability to assist with the care, handling, and use of laboratory animals, or willingness to acquire these skills.
 Knowledge of laboratory safety, chemical storage, hazardous materials handling, and Safety Data Sheets, or willingness to acquire this knowledge.
 Ability to work independently, as well as to communicate and interact effectively in a professional and courteous manner with faculty, staff and students.

 About this position:
 We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to strengthen Later's company-wide security posture through hands-on engineering, thoughtful collaboration, and pragmatic standards. This role blends deep security expertise with strong software engineering skills, with a focus on application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure development practices, vulnerability management, compliance enablement, and security improvements across our corporate systems and business operations. You'll partner closely with teams across Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, IT, Legal, People, Finance, and other business functions to embed security into Later's systems, tools, workflows, and operating practices. A core focus of this role is helping Later mature its security capabilities in support of SOC 2 and other compliance expectations through practical controls, automation, evidence-ready processes, and clear guidance that works across the company. This role is ideal for a senior security practitioner who thinks like a defender, builds like a software engineer, and leads through influence across both technical and non-technical teams.
 What you'll be doing:
 Company-Wide Security Strategy & Compliance 
 Assess and continuously improve Later's overall security posture across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, corporate systems, vendor tooling, and business workflows.
 Define and implement scalable security standards, best practices, and guardrails that support SOC 2 readiness through practical, automated, and auditable solutions.
 Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, Product, Legal, People, Finance, and business leaders to align security priorities with company goals, risk reduction, and delivery timelines.
 Translate SOC 2 and related compliance requirements into sustainable technical and operational controls, procedures, and evidence collection practices.
 Identify security gaps across the company, prioritize remediation efforts, and help teams make pragmatic, risk-based decisions.
 Support company-wide security awareness, secure operating practices, and adoption of security controls across business teams.
 Technical Execution 
 Build and maintain internal security tools, automation, and services that support secure development, compliance workflows, vulnerability management, corporate security operations, and operational visibility.
 Design and implement security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including secure build and deploy patterns, security scanning, dependency management, container scanning, and secret management.
 Support application security efforts, including secure design reviews, threat modeling, code review guidance, API security, microservices security patterns, and remediation planning.
 Improve cloud infrastructure and corporate systems security through hardening, monitoring, configuration review, Infrastructure-as-Code security scanning, access reviews, and secure operational patterns.
 Collaborate with technical and business teams to identify vulnerabilities and control gaps, explain impact clearly, and drive effective remediation.
 Strengthen security observability and response readiness through logging, alerting, detection engineering, incident response improvements, and company-wide security process maturity.
 Collaboration & Enablement 
 Partner with teams across the company to identify, understand, and fix security issues in a collaborative, non-blocking way.
 Provide pragmatic security guidance on designs, implementations, vendor tools, operational practices, and business workflows.
 Communicate security risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
 Embed security into development workflows, corporate systems, and company operating practices without slowing teams unnecessarily.
 Support SOC 2 and related compliance efforts through automation, well-defined controls, reliable evidence practices, and cross-functional coordination.
 What success looks like:
 Within the first 90 days, you've completed a security posture assessment, identified the highest-priority gaps, and have a remediation roadmap that's been reviewed and socialized with key stakeholders across Engineering, IT, and Leadership.
 By 6 months, core SOC 2 controls are documented, automated where possible, and evidence collection is running reliably without manual heroics from any single team.
 Security is embedded into Later's CI/CD pipelines, with scanning, secret management, and container security integrated and maintained as a standard part of the development lifecycle.
 Teams across Engineering, IT, and the business have a clear point of contact for security questions, a shared understanding of the risk landscape, and security guidance that helps them move faster, not slower.
 Later's security observability has materially improved: logging, alerting, and detection coverage are in place, and the company has a documented, practiced incident response process.
 What you bring:
 We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!
 5-7+ years of experience as a Security Engineer or Software Engineer with a strong security focus.
 Proven ability to build and operate production-quality software, automation, and internal tooling.
 Strong understanding of application security, infrastructure security, cloud security, secure CI/CD practices, and corporate security controls.
 Hands-on experience with vulnerability management, secure software development, threat modeling, remediation workflows, and operational security improvements.
 Experience with security frameworks and standards such as OWASP, NIST, CIS Controls, SOC 2, and ISO 27001, and the ability to apply them in production and business environments.
 Experience supporting SOC 2 compliance efforts through practical, automated, and auditable controls.
 Familiarity with cloud security platforms such as AWS Security Hub, Azure Security Center, or GCP Security Command Center.

What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. 
 That is the whole job.
 Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
 So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
 You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
 Here is what "end to end" actually means.
 You are the account manager. We do not have any.  You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.  Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.  We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
 You can live anywhere.  We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 What the job looks like 
 Own a set of DTC accounts  as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
 Own the client relationship.  There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
 Audit before you touch anything.  Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
 Run brand and non brand as different businesses.  Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
 Know what PMax is actually doing.  The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
 Keep Google's automation on a leash.  Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
 Own the feed.  Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
 Own the tracking.  GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.  Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
 Build the things the account needs.  Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
 You are a fit if 
 You have done this with real money.  Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
 You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
 You are AI native, and you build.  This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
 You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.  You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
 You are skeptical of your own numbers.  You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
 You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.  Where you live is up to you.
 Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
 You are not a fit if 
 "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
 You want to be told what to do this week.
 You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
 You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
 Why this role is exciting 
 This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
 You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
 You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
 You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

À propos du programme 
 Si vous avez récemment obtenu votre diplôme et recherchez bien plus qu’un emploi de bureau — si la chaîne d’approvisionnement, la vente, le développement des affaires et l’entrepreneuriat vous passionnent — voici votre chance de bâtir une véritable carrière à partir de la base.
 Notre Programme de perfectionnement des gestionnaires est un parcours accéléré et pratique qui vous apprendra à gérer une entreprise de A à Z. Vous acquerrez une expérience concrète, profiterez d’un solide encadrement et bénéficierez d’une rémunération concurrentielle, d’un programme complet d’avantages sociaux et d’une participation aux bénéfices — tout en vous préparant à diriger votre propre établissement.
 Déménagement

 Équité et bienveillance
 Confiance et respect
 Écoute généreuse
 Franc-parler
 Diversité, inclusion et possibilités 
 EMCO Corporation s’engage à bâtir un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où chaque coéquipier et coéquipière peut réussir. Nous croyons que la diversité des parcours, des expériences, des perspectives et des idées fait de nous une organisation plus forte et un meilleur partenaire pour notre clientèle.
 Nous encourageons activement les candidatures de femmes, de personnes autochtones, de minorités visibles, de personnes en situation de handicap, de membres de la communauté LGBTQ2S+ et de personnes de tous horizons. Nous sommes particulièrement déterminés à accroître la représentation des femmes dans les postes de leadership et dans l’ensemble du secteur de la distribution en gros pour l’industrie de la construction, en créant un environnement où le talent, le rendement et le potentiel ouvrent la voie aux possibilités d’avancement.
 Ce que vous ferez 
 En tant que gestionnaire junior régional en distribution, vous suivrez un programme structuré en quatre phases conçu pour vous donner une vue d’ensemble du fonctionnement d’une entreprise prospère — de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de l’exploitation jusqu’à la vente, au leadership et à la stratégie.
 Vous ne vous contenterez pas d’observer : vous prendrez en charge des projets, gérerez des comptes, établirez des relations avec la clientèle et prendrez de véritables décisions d’affaires, le tout avec l’encadrement de leaders expérimentés à travers le pays.

 Phase 1 : Dépôt et service à la clientèle (12 mois) 
 Acquérez une expérience pratique au cœur des activités de l’entreprise.
 Expédition, réception et gestion des stocks
 Connaissance des produits et coordination avec les fournisseurs

 Prestation d’un service axé sur les solutions et produisant un impact concret

 Stimulez la croissance avec une mentalité entrepreneuriale.
 Repérage et obtention de nouvelles occasions d’affaires

 Accroissement de notre présence sur le marché et renforcement des partenariats avec la clientèle
 Apprentissage de stratégies de vente proactive de haut niveau

 Direction et encadrement d’une équipe
 Définition de la stratégie, de la vision et des objectifs de rendement

 Transition de gestionnaire junior à leader d’entreprise

 Straight Talk

Le poste mesure l’adoption et rend visible la valeur créée, accompagne les équipes dans les initiatives et l’application des pratiques approuvées, assure le suivi des demandes, constitue la porte d’entrée des demandes IA internes et gère la logique d’usage des plateformes (groupes, distribution, limites et budgets d’usage).  2. Responsabilités 
 Mesure, suivi des initiatives et rapports

 Tenir à jour l’inventaire des plateformes, outils et cas d’usage IA internes (secteur, propriétaire d’affaires, niveau de risque attribué par la gouvernance IA), en collaboration avec TI et la gouvernance IA.

 Adoption et accompagnement 
 Entretenir des liens réguliers avec les différentes sphères de l’entreprise pour comprendre les usages, besoins et irritants. 
 Assurer la coordination opérationnelle du comité des ambassadeurs IA, le suivi de ses dossiers et la circulation de l’information. 
 Proposer des pratiques et des guides d’application; accompagner les équipes dans l’amélioration de leurs usages. 
 Favoriser une cadence de communication interne sur l’IA, organiser les communications avec les ambassadeurs (qui contribuent au contenu) et maintenir une vigie ciblée sur les outils et pratiques IA. 
 Transmettre les situations à risque ou nécessitant un arbitrage aux responsables compétents. 
 Diffuser les nouvelles politiques, normes et pratiques approuvées par l’entremise des ambassadeurs IA et des gestionnaires, et s’assurer de leur compréhension.

 Communication et présentation 
 Vulgariser les concepts, les enjeux et les nouveautés de l’IA en termes clairs et accessibles pour les utilisateurs de tous les secteurs (guides, foire aux questions, capsules, démonstrations). 
 Concevoir et produire des présentations, des documents et d’autres supports de communication destinés aux utilisateurs, aux gestionnaires et à la direction. 
 Présenter l’état de l’adoption, les résultats et les recommandations aux dirigeants et aux comités, en adaptant le message et le niveau de détail à l’auditoire. 
 Animer des séances d’information, de démonstration et de partage de pratiques auprès des équipes et des ambassadeurs IA. 
 Nouveau processus de gestion des demandes

 Servir de porte d’entrée unique de toutes les demandes IA internes, les relayer aux instances concernées (dont le Laboratoire IA lorsqu’une expérimentation est requise) et en suivre l’avancement.

 Appliquer les critères d’accueil établis (propriétaire d’affaires, usage visé, données concernées) afin que les demandes soient complètes avant leur acheminement. 
 Acheminer les demandes selon les voies d’escalade et les droits décisionnels établis, en fonction du niveau de risque et du type de demande. 
 Logique d’usage des plateformes 
 Définir et maintenir la logique de distribution, des groupes, des limites et des budgets d’usage des plateformes IA internes approuvées, et en suivre l’utilisation. 
 Effectuer les ajustements courants autorisés et recommander les changements nécessitant une décision ou une intervention spécialisée. 
 Collaborer avec TI, sécurité, la gouvernance IA et la direction IA sur les groupes, accès aux fonctionnalités, les limites et les budgets d’usage. 
 Repérer les anomalies d’usage (volumes inhabituels, accès ou groupes inattendus) et les signaler à TI et sécurité. 
 Signaler aux instances concernées les changements importants apportés par les fournisseurs aux plateformes (modèles, fonctionnalités, conditions) pouvant nécessiter une revue. 
 Contribuer à la revue périodique et au retrait éventuel des plateformes et des fonctionnalités en fournissant les données d’usage et d’adoption. 
 Incidents et conformité opérationnelle 
 Recevoir et documenter les signalements d’incidents ou de situations à risque liés à l’usage de l’IA, les acheminer aux responsables compétents (sécurité, gouvernance IA, juridique, Ressources humaines selon le cas) et en suivre le dossier jusqu’à la clôture. 
 Observer l’application des politiques d’utilisation et des pratiques approuvées et signaler les écarts à la gouvernance IA. 
 Consigner les leçons apprises des incidents et des écarts et les intégrer aux guides d’application.

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .  
 Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. 
 Research Analyst - JLL 
 What this job involves: 
JLL is seeking a Research Analyst to join our team in downtown Calgary. In this role, you will support the local Office Leasing team and contribute to the success of JLL's National Research platform. You will track, collect, and analyze real estate market intelligence across the Calgary office sector and the national data centre market. Collaborating closely with national research colleagues and local brokers, you will transform complex datasets into actionable market insights and presentation materials that differentiate JLL from competitors. This role suits an ambitious professional with a strong interest in commercial real estate, urban development, and the Calgary economy. 
 What your day-to-day will look like: 
 Collect, audit, and maintain commercial real estate datasets covering properties, lease transactions, availabilities, developments, and ownership across Calgary office and national data centre markets. 
 Build and publish regular Calgary office market reports and presentation decks covering Downtown, Beltline, and Suburban submarkets. 
 Synthesize executed lease transactions and building stacking plans to evaluate tenant movement, scale, and industry clustering. 
 Maintain and update research databases and Excel models weekly, leading in-depth quarterly market reviews with local brokers. 
 Design market visualizations and GIS-based thematic maps using JLL’s proprietary mapping and analytics tools. 
 Deliver research presentations and market overviews to internal brokerage teams and external clients. 
 Leverage technology and artificial intelligence applications to streamline data collection, auditing, and reporting workflows. 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and database management systems. 
 Demonstrated data collection, auditing, validation, and organizational capabilities. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail. 
 Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. 
 Motivated, self-starting work ethic with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment. 
 Strong interest in economic market drivers, urban development, and the Calgary commercial real estate market. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Real Estate, Urban Planning, Finance, or a related field.

Under the general direction of the Café 77 managers and supervisors, this position is responsible for the daily receiving, rotation, inventory, stock levels, and delivery of orders and products to the Café 77 dining location. This position is responsible for a wide variety of food service-related duties in addition to order receiving, including but not limited to: station setup, food and beverage preparation, customer service, teamwork, professional communication verbally and via email, restocking of supplies, general cleaning and organizing assignments, cashiering, and assisting with catered events.
Washington and Lee University actively promotes a dynamic and welcoming environment that allows students and employees of multiple backgrounds and perspectives to learn, work, and thrive together. Successful candidates will contribute to that environment and exhibit potential for excellence in their areas of expertise.
 Essential Functions: 
 Using FIFO and ServSafe measures, in addition to general food safety and storage, this position is responsible for the daily receiving, rotation, inventory, stock levels, and delivery of orders and products to the Café 77 dining location. 
 Preforms a wide variety of food service-related duties in addition to order receiving, including but not limited to; morning station setup, food and beverage preparation, intercampus-food order pickup, customer service, teamwork, professional communication verbally and via email, restocking of supplies, general cleaning and organizing assignments, cashiering, assisting with catered events and other duties as assigned by Dining Services leadership.
 Responsible for assisting the Café 77 leadership with organization, stock and inventory related tasks on a daily basis.
 Responsible for transitioning in a timely manner upon the completion of core stock/inventory related duties on shift, to working positions within the Café 77 dining operation as assigned for the remainder of scheduled shift. Duties may include but not be limited to: rostered onto a station during operational service, Dining Room Attendant, dish and trash duties, properly filtering fryer daily, properly disposing of used cooking oil and refilling of machine(s), and other duties as assigned.
 Additional related duties as assigned.

 ServSafe certification or willingness to acquire within a year of employment date. 
 Ability to multitask in a fast paced work environment.
